snippet.title: Laser Lightshow - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Manipulate lasers through hundreds of handcrafted puzzles using mirrors, prisms, teleporters, wires, and dozens of other mechanics. Then build and share your own puzzles with the full-featured level editor.

🎮 Wishlist Laser Lightshow on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2056530/Laser_Lightshow/

⚡ Demo — September 9, 2026
🎉 Steam Next Fest — October 19–26, 2026
🚀 Full Release — November 4, 2026

Get ready for the Lightshow, 5 years in the making!

#LaserLightshow #IndieGame #PuzzleGame
